units: <cite ref="Berakhot 22a:24">Ber. 22ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>תקן ח׳ בת וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>חוצבא</he>) ordained that a pitcher containing nine kab must be used for purification.
<cite ref="Berakhot 22a:25">Ib.</cite> <he>אתבר חַצְבֵּיה וכ׳</he> R. N.’s pitcher is broken (the rule he laid down is rejected).

<cite ref="Beitzah 30a:4">Bets. 30ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חַצְבִּין</he>, <he>חַצְבֵּי</he>. Targ. II Esth. III, 8 <he>מלקטין פישרי טבת ויתיבין בחַצְבֵּי תמוז</he> they collect the thawing snows of the winter and put them in summer pitchers (coolers).—Bets. l. c. <he>מליין חַצְבַּיְיהוּ וכ׳</he> filled their pitchers with water.
<cite ref="Berakhot 28a:3">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ חוורין וכ׳</he> white pitchers full of ashes (unworthy students).
